mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts by more than 5% over the last two months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 2% over the last two months signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable monetary policy, which reduces uncertainty and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising real GDP (GDPC1) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the last six months signals a strong demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances with rising GDPC1 and falling UNRATE, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 over the last month, combined with a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3%, signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines > 100,000 and UNRATE increases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
